initial_hypothesis: V4 initialization enabled at startup was initially interpreted as all large DATA extents being zero-filled, unlike v7.
correction: take_admitted_group computes initialize_extents from batch size for both formats. V4 ExtentInitializer::prepare receives that zero_fill boolean. Thus both large-batch paths largely use allocation without zero filling; v4 startup initialization is separate.
conclusion: The initial generalization is rejected. Forced large-write initialization is a diagnostic intervention, not a reproduction of the ordinary v4 large-batch path or a retained optimization. Its throughput differences are confounded by different storage/sync latencies.
